source_state: Local release candidate validated before the exact-source GitHub Build. CI must reproduce the recorded Nexus and Core artifact hashes before publication.
changes: Keep integrated singleplayer server ticks running while a filled-map Space Unit screen is open so detail LOD generation and vanilla color delivery continue.
Request and render separate matching resolutions at 200%, 400%, 800% and 1600% rather than leaving every zoom on the coarsest base map.
Add an integrated Client GameTest using real owner requests, server-side LOD generation and vanilla map packets without client map-data injection.
Preserve existing pause behavior for non-map Space Unit interfaces.
consumer_impact: Nexus-only Screen behavior and Nexus-owned tests. TotemCore APIs, Observer protocols, input suppression, privacy boundaries, Remnant lifecycle and Discord audit events are unchanged. No sibling repository was edited.

network_resolution_regression.path: real owner request -> server LOD build -> vanilla map color packet -> production Screen layer
network_resolution_regression.paired_causality: The valid fixture fails at 200% with no layers and serverPaused=true when only the isPauseScreen override is removed; the same fixture passes all four zooms with the override restored.

client_runtime.graphics: SDL X11, Xvfb, Vulkan Lavapipe software rendering; no physical-GPU performance claim

observer_e2e.topology: dedicated server + Target JVM + Observer JVM

limitations: The new regression test asserts matching rendered layer IDs and exact map palette colors; captured screenshots are visually reviewed evidence rather than screenshot-RGB assertions.
The runtime uses Vulkan Lavapipe under Xvfb, not physical Apple Silicon or native desktop GPU performance acceptance.
The confirmed cause is integrated-singleplayer pausing; it is not evidence that the same pause cause applies to multiplayer.

independent_review.finding: No findings; no release-blocking implementation issue found.
independent_review.remaining_limit: No separate non-map pause regression was added; the implementation condition is limited to FILLED_MAP and other interfaces delegate to the parent behavior.

publication_authorization: User explicitly instructed the validated fix to be uploaded directly to Modrinth.
pending_gates: public API and CDN artifact read-back
